column3: Ben has 24 marbles. He gives away 8. How many are left?
There are 5 bags with 4 apples in each. How many apples are there?
18 sweets are shared between 3 children. How many does each child get?
A toy costs 25p. You pay 30p. How much change do you get?
School starts at 9:00. What time is one hour later?
Mia has 32 stickers. She buys 7 more. How many does she have?
There are 40 birds. 12 fly away. How many remain?
A book has 50 pages. You read 20. How many are left?
Which number is halfway between 10 and 20?
Lucy has 18 pencils. She puts them into 2 equal groups. How many are in each group?
A bus has 14 passengers. 6 get off. How many stay on?
Tom has £1. He spends 40p. How much is left?
There are 7 days in a week. How many days are in 2 weeks?
